record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Munchlax (1 star) and Snorlax (2 stars), both with passive GLUTTON, declare BODY_SLAM. The strategy is shared; the units differ in stars and stats.
record.summary: Single-target SPECIAL. The strategy requests round(fraction x the CASTER's current maxHP x (1 + AP/100)) with fraction 0.3 / 0.3 / 0.5 / 0.8 (fallback 0.8) and passes apBoost = false, so AP applies once (in the strategy) while a downstream crit still applies. No paralysis or any other status, movement or heal. maxHP is the current value at cast time; this record does not account for every source that changes it.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

effects.scaling: requested = round(fraction x caster.maxHP x (1 + AP/100)) in the strategy; handleSpecialDamage gets apBoost = false so it adds no second AP factor (executed: AP 100 requests 600, not 1200); a downstream crit still multiplies by critPower (executed: 300 -> 600, AP 100 + crit -> 1200; needs ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false). maxHP is the entity's current value, not the catalog base. Executed: maxHP 1000 -> 300 / 300 / 500 / 800 by stars, maxHP 333 at AP 50 -> round(149.85) = 150, maxHP 120 -> 36.
effects.resolution: requested amount = the rounded fraction of maxHP; applied change = after the optional crit factor, then PokemonState.handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF) (ceil, minimum 1), applies shields and other steps; blocked (0) by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (executed); a dead or resurrecting target takes nothing. The returned takenDamage is not read. No status is requested (executed: caster and target status unchanged).

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 0.5 and 0.8 entries are declared in the tables but unused by the bound baseline classes (Munchlax 1, Snorlax 2). maxPP is 100 and range 1 for both.

record.positionalConditions: None read beyond needing a target.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast recomputes from the caster's current maxHP at that moment, so the request follows later maxHP changes; which sources change maxHP in a fight (including the GLUTTON passive) was not accounted for completely.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: fraction 0.3 of the caster's maxHP for both units (0.5 / 0.8 declared for 3 / 4 stars). Requested = round(fraction x maxHP x (1 + AP/100)); applied: x crit factor on a crit, then SPE_DEF division (ceil, min 1) and shields in handleDamage.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPE_DEF division with min 1 and the block/dead gates were cited
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence)
Crit resolution: only the damage-side multiplier and the canCritByDefault gate were read
Every source that changes the caster's maxHP in a fight (only the addMaxHP helper and the three GLUTTON growth sites were cited)
unresolved: No complete GLUTTON account is given: how maxHP growth (pick phase, dish, cooking) reaches the in-fight entity was not traced beyond the cited sites
Whether any item or synergy effect changes BODY_SLAM beyond what is listed

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (handleSpecialDamage) and the real BodySlamStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units with controlled callbacks (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, section CATCHUP_E2); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed (stand-in caster with set maxHP, target HP 5000): the fraction table, the round formula, apBoost false (AP once), the downstream crit, the Protected case and the unchanged statuses.
